title: workload.deployment.degraded v1 data
description: A workload stopped meeting its readiness or availability target. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

reason.description: Why the workload is degraded. `Unknown` is deliberate: a consumer must handle a reason it does not recognise rather than fail closed on an enum it was compiled against.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Never parsed by a consumer — the machine-readable fact is `reason`.
